TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Eastern Banda Sea
DATE 19 November 2028 · 1030 local
SIDE People's Liberation Army Navy
WINDOW 45 min, closes at 68
Z-9 helicopter. Photo: Sparktour · CC BY-SA 4.0 · cropped
"We must think in terms of tomorrow."
- Gen. Henry H. 'Hap' Arnold, US Army Air Forces

EASTERN BANDA SEA, 1030. DRAGON EYE 05 is collecting the convoy picture west of Kai. The coalition has ordered a two-aircraft intercept. Expect the F-35s at about minute eight, closing from the south-east; they are cleared to engage our aircraft. You may defend the KJ-500 and engage those fighters.

Two J-15s, FLYING SHARK 83 and 84, are allocated to escort DRAGON EYE regardless of your purchases. Your own CAP pair and patrol aircraft can reinforce them if allocated. Use the first minutes to establish the escort and ready the screen's air defence. Stay between the interceptors and the KJ-500; do not send every fighter after a retreating contact and leave the radar aircraft bare.

Break the intercept by destroying at least one fighter, then bring DRAGON EYE into the return box north-west, with no incoming weapons still threatening the force. Classifying CORAL PIONEER, MOGAMI and MAYA earns a separate intelligence bonus and does not block the exit. The three merchants, both Japanese escorts, the Growler and Rivet Joint use neutral tactical symbols: their protection is real and defensive weapons settings do not authorise an attack on them.
The Kai fishing boats, ferry and Sydney-Hong Kong service remain protected. Nothing here decides tomorrow's Common Sea engagement.
COMMAND NET: A mission-specific tactical report follows eight minutes after the start. It is advice from the command team, not a new sensor detection.
Fleet headquarters
COMMANDER'S INTENT

Protect Dragon Eye and defeat the intercepting fighters. The merchants, Japanese ships, Growler and Rivet Joint are protected non-belligerents; none is a strike target. Record their classes if the tactical picture permits.
• Break the fighter intercept and bring Dragon Eye to the return box
• Do not attack the convoy or protected surveillance aircraft
• Keep Dragon Eye 05 alive
• Destroy at least one intercepting fighter
• Classify Coral Pioneer and both Japanese escorts if practicable
• Harm no protected non-belligerent or civil contact

Your screen and any allocated aircraft, plus Dragon Eye 05 and an allocated J-15 pair. Hostile: two F-35As entering at minute eight. Protected non-belligerents: the convoy, Japanese escorts, Growler and Rivet Joint; civil traffic remains protected.

The planned window is 45 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 23 minutes more; the operation is closed at 68 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
